messages:
maria: heads up — after the fallback rollout last night billing totals and the audit bucket don't line up. small customers are undercharged relative to token logs. likely attribution gap when requests hit the fallback path.
aj: can you paste an example?
mar ia: here's a truncated trace, redacted tenant id but same pattern: 
```
{\n  \"request_id\": \"r_abc123\",\n  \"tenant\": \"T-REDACTED\",\n  \"requested_model\": \"rwd-large-v1\",\n  \"served_model\": \"rwd-small-quant\",\n  \"tokens_total\": 420,\n  \"billing_tokens\": null,  // null on fallback path\n  \"provenance\": null\n}
```
aj: ah — billing_tokens is null when the fallback runtime path returns early. we probably forgot to populate the attribution envelope for the compatibility shim.
trent: is this the path where we proxy to the legacy runtime? the shim should attach a provenance pointer, not raw tokens, so we can reconcile later. but if it's missing we lose attribution.
vlad: tradeoff: attach full token footprint per request (accurate, big), or store small "receipt" pointers we can expand later (compact, needs backfill infrastructure).
sasha: agree. for most tenants compact receipts + deterministic fingerprint would be sufficient and save storage. but we need an always-present idempotency key and model lineage fields (`requested_model`, `served_model`, `model_variant_id`).
kevin: also need to consider latency SLOs. adding a sync enrichment call to the billing path will increase p50. prefer async enrichment on write to billing-audit topic.
maria: proposal: 1) ensure every codepath writes a minimal envelope to billing-ingest topic with: request_id, tenant, requested_model, served_model (may be same), token_fingerprint, token_counts (optional), and a provenance pointer (store_bucket_key). 2) keep a separate billing-audit topic with verbose records only when tenant-level debug is enabled.
trent: how do we generate token_fingerprint? deterministic hash of prefix+user_id+seq? we need stable across retries.
vlad: use canonicalized token histogram + sha256 -> fixed-length fingerprint. small to store, can be used for joins in backfill.
sasha: for backfills we need the original input shard reference. add `ingest_offset` and `source_partition` to envelope so we can rehydrate later.
aj: ops question: if we use compact receipts and later expand them in backfill, how do we avoid double-charging when the expand runs?
kevin: lifecycle: billing-ingest accepts envelope with a `commit_state` enum: PENDING -> FINALIZED. only FINALIZED increments the ledger. backfill/enrichment can move PENDING->FINALIZED after attaching computed billing_tokens. Idempotency key prevents double apply.
maria: exact. implement ledger transaction with idempotency using `request_id` + `enrichment_version`.
deploy-bot: deploy rwd-fallback-shim v2 to prod finished :rocket: (1758001255)
trent: note: need schema versioning for envelope. add `schema_v` and `enrichment_v`. when we change what fingerprint contains we bump `schema_v` and keep compatibility in the reconciler.
vlad: measurement: run canary that enables verbose audit for 2% tenants for 24h, compare token sums to pre-change baseline.
sasha: operational play: add a check in reconciliation job that flags any request with served_model != requested_model and null billing_tokens for > 1h. alert to eng-platform.
aj: quick patch idea: short-term hotfix: if billing_tokens is null and served_model exists, fallback to best-effort token estimate using cached tokenization model and write an auto-enrich event. may be slightly off but avoids underbilling.
kevin: ok but make sure that estimate is marked `estimated:true` and excluded from SLA-sensitive reports.
maria: next steps: (1) formalize envelope schema PR, (2) add failure modes and surface reconcile alerts, (3) canary verbose audit. i'll open RFC follow-up with schema and reconciliation state machine.
trent: 👍 please include examples of PENDING->FINALIZED flows and the idempotent apply semantics.
vlad: also evaluate storage cost: compact receipt ~200 bytes vs full tokens ~5-10KB. estimate daily QPS * 200B. i'll run numbers.
sasha: tagging for ops: @oncall-metering to watch reconcile alerts during rollout.
maria: thanks all — i'll post the RFC link once open. :white_check_mark:
